coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 18 ground-truth variable items (22%): A100 hardware, full lookup during encoding and decoding, no distant-memory lookup, and mean key-vector representation.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses different backbone models and incorrect window, initial-token, memory-budget, block, and context settings. Omits decoding-only lookup and the specified representative-token baseline, incorrectly calling mean pooling the default. Replaces Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and QA with other benchmarks rather than measuring accuracy on the required tasks. Fixed fp16 precision and the same seed/configuration are not established. Numerous additional experimental factors do not match the target design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no findings about full memory lookup improving performance, the collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or representative tokens outperforming mean representations.
